title: Casimir-Connection Monodromy and Quantum Weyl Groups
exact_target: Identify the monodromy of the trigonometric Casimir connection with the affine quantum Weyl-group action.

status_qualification: The identification of the finite-dimensional Yangian and quantum-loop module data is part of the proposed comparison. Equality of abstract braid groups alone is insufficient, and a result for sl_2 alone does not settle every simple Lie algebra.
